text.ms:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan

Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Perbekalan) 2017.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa

pada 1 Januari 2017.

Pengeluaran bagi perbelanjaan bagi tahun 2017

2. Suatu jumlah wang yang tidak melebihi tujuh ratus tujuh puluh dua juta satu ratus

empat puluh empat ribu ringgit (RM772,144,000) hendaklah dikeluarkan daripada

Kumpulan Wang Keselamatan Sosial bagi perbelanjaan untuk pentadbiran Rancangan

Keselamatan Sosial bagi tahun 2017 sebagaimana yang diperuntukkan dalam Jadual.

JADUAL

Maksud Peruntukan

Emolumen RM 224,789,000

Bekalan dan perkhidmatan RM 219,730,000

Pemberian, bayaran tetap dan bayaran lain RM 61,415,000

Perbelanjaan lain RM 62,224,000

Harta tanah, loji dan peralatan RM 203,986,000

Jumlah RM 772,144,000

Dibuat 3 Ogos 2017

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXII]

DATO' SRI (DR) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Menteri Sumber Manusia

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY ACT 1969

EMPLOYEES' SOCIAL SECURITY (SUPPLY) REGULATIONS 2017

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 72 of the Employees' Social Security

Act 1969 [Act 4], the Minister makes the following regulations:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) These regulations may be cited as the Employees' Social Security (Supply)

Regulations 2017.

(2) These Regulations are deemed to have come into operation

on 1 January 2017.

Issue for expenditure for the year 2017

2. A sum not exceeding seven hundred and seventy-two million one hundred and

fourty-four thousand ringgit (RM772,144,000) shall be issued out of the Social Security

Fund for expenditure on the administration of the Scheme of Social Security for the

year 2017 as provided in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

Purpose Allocation

Emoluments RM 224,789,000

Supplies and services RM 219,730,000

Grants, fixed payments and other payments RM 61,415,000

Other expenditures RM 62,224,000

Landed properties, plants and equipment RM 203,986,000

___________________

Total RM 772,144,000

Made 3 August 2017

[KSM/PUU/(S)/600-1/2/11/5; PN(PU2)58/XXII]

DATO' SRI (DR) RICHARD RIOT ANAK JAEM

Minister of Human Resources
